The pipe symbol

```{r}
my_numbers <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)

sum(my_numbers)
my_numbers <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)

print(my_numbers |>
        sum() |>
        sqrt())

```
Renaming variables 
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
migration <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
migration_selected <- migration|>
  select(winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat)|>
  distinct()|>
  rename(
    Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude = awestlat
  )
  
gt(migration_selected)
     
```
Excluding spain
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
migration <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_exc <- migration |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)

```
Grouping and sumerising 
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)


migration <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
migration <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")

bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_exc <- migration |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(pslon, na.rm = TRUE))

gt(lat_df)
```

```{r}
df_dept <- read_csv("data/depts.csv")
df_score <- read_csv("data/scores.csv")
gt(df_score)
gt(df_dept)
full_join_example <- full_join(df_dept, df_score)
gt(full_join_example)
inner_join_example <- inner_join(df_dept, df_score)
gt(inner_join_example)
```
